decided: 2026-07-02 (the author): format arms carry SHARED VALUES - each category's nudge derives from the NUMBERS arm's wave-1 share and the words/pictures arms carry those same values. The design principle 'only the format changes' wins over per-arm nudging. A pictures ceiling recurring at shared values is handled by the registered no-room rule, not by different values. stimuli.json stays UNTOUCHED this wave: the generator applies these overrides in memory; values lock into stimuli.json once, at the final lock (G3).

backpacks.basis: wave-1 numbers arm 49.5% -> mechanical nudge (CALIBRATION_WAVE1 s2)

bluetooth_speakers.basis: wave-1 numbers arm 61.9% -> mechanical nudge; shared by the words + pictures arms

hard_drives.basis: wave-1 numbers arm 69.4% -> mechanical nudge; shared by the words + pictures arms

televisions.basis: wave-1 numbers arm 60.6% -> mechanical nudge; shared by the words + pictures arms

electric_kettles.basis: wave-1 numbers arm 72.2% (TARGET = HF in this category) -> mechanical nudge

robot_vacuums.basis: wave-1 numbers arm 33.7% (COMP = HF too popular) -> mechanical nudge

standing_desks.basis: wave-1 numbers arm 80.1% HARD FLAG (TARGET = HF) -> mechanical nudge; hard limit binds only after the final wave

no_override.water_bottles: the NUMBERS arm (pub_t2, 41.7%) is IN BAND, so the shared values are the CURRENT values (HF 16 oz / $8.99; HD 48 oz / $24.99); the words + pictures arms are re-tested at those unchanged shared values as pure format re-checks.
